exposure: number of previous cesarean sections (1-2 vs 3 or more)
cohort: 850 patients undergoing repeat cesarean section at a tertiary level maternity hospital in Ankara, Turkey
finding: While a higher number of previous cesarean sections was associated with increased prevalence of intraperitoneal adhesions and placenta previa, there were no significant differences in adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes between women with 1-2 or 3 or more previous cesarean sections.
